package standings

import (
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
	"gno.land/r/sys/users"
)

// giveName registers name for a in r/sys/users, as the users realm's genesis controller
// does; the registry outlives reset, so a name given once stays.
func giveName(cur realm, a address, name string) {
	if !users.ResolveAddress(a).IsDeleted() {
		return
	}
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/sys/users/init"))
	if err := users.RegisterUser(cross(cur), name, a); err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}
}

func ranks(list []Standing) string {
	out := ""
	for _, s := range list {
		out += strconv.Itoa(s.Rank) + " "
	}
	return out
}

func TestStandingOfUnrated(t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	s := StandingOf(carol)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, s.Rank)
	uassert.Equal(t, carol.String(), s.Player)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", s.Name)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", s.MainClan)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1000, s.Rating)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, s.Wins+s.Losses+s.Draws)
}

func TestStandingOfNamed(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	giveName(cur, alice, "alice")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(arenaV0))
	Record(cross(cur), alice, bob, "Pickers", "Ironhide", "a")
	s := StandingOf(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, "alice", s.Name)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, s.Rank)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Pickers", s.MainClan)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1016, s.Rating)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, s.Wins)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", StandingOf(bob).Name, "an address without a name has none")
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, StandingOf(bob).Rank)
}

func TestLeaderboardSharedRankAcrossPages(t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	seed(alice, 1016)
	seed(bob, 1016)
	seed(carol, 1016)
	seed(dave, 952)
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 1 ", ranks(Leaderboard(0, 2)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 4 ", ranks(Leaderboard(2, 2)), "a page that opens inside a tie keeps its shared rank")
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 1 1 4 ", ranks(Leaderboard(0, 50)))
}

func TestLeaderboardLimits(t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, nil, "limit must be 1 to 50", func() { Leaderboard(0, 0) })
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, nil, "limit must be 1 to 50", func() { Leaderboard(0, 51) })
	uassert.PanicsWithMessage(t, nil, "offset must not be negative", func() { Leaderboard(-1, 10) })
	list := Leaderboard(0, 50)
	uassert.True(t, list != nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(list))
}

func TestLeaderboardFiftyNamed(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	for i := 0; i < 50; i++ {
		a := testutils.TestAddress("player" + strconv.Itoa(i))
		giveName(cur, a, "player"+strconv.Itoa(i))
		seed(a, 1000+i)
	}
	list := Leaderboard(0, 50)
	urequire.Equal(t, 50, len(list))
	for i, s := range list {
		uassert.Equal(t, 1049-i, s.Rating)
		uassert.Equal(t, i+1, s.Rank)
		uassert.Equal(t, "player"+strconv.Itoa(49-i), s.Name)
	}
}

func TestRatedPlayers(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, RatedPlayers())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(arenaV0))
	Record(cross(cur), alice, bob, "Pickers", "Ironhide", "a")
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, RatedPlayers())
}

func TestClanStandings(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	list := ClanStandings()
	uassert.True(t, list != nil)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(list))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(arenaV0))
	Record(cross(cur), alice, bob, "Pickers", "Ironhide", "a")
	Record(cross(cur), carol, dave, "Delvers", "Delvers", "a")
	list = ClanStandings()
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(list), "a clan with only mirror matches is not listed")
	uassert.Equal(t, "Pickers", list[0].Clan)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, list[0].Rank)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1008, list[0].Rating)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, list[0].Wins)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Ironhide", list[1].Clan)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, list[1].Rank)
	uassert.Equal(t, 992, list[1].Rating)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, list[1].Losses)
}

func TestResultsPageAcrossChunks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(arenaV0))
	for i := 0; i < 65; i++ {
		Record(cross(cur), alice, bob, "Pickers", "Ironhide", "a")
	}
	page := Results(62, 5)
	urequire.Equal(t, 3, len(page))
	for i, r := range page {
		uassert.Equal(t, 63+i, r.Seq)
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, 65, ResultCount())
}

	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm(arenaV0))
	Record(cross(cur), alice, bob, "Pickers", "Ironhide", "a")
	Record(cross(cur), carol, dave, "Delvers", "Pickers", "draw")
	Record(cross(cur), carol, alice, "Delvers", "Pickers", "a")
	Record(cross(cur), dave, bob, "Ironhide", "Ironhide", "b")

func showStanding(s standing) string {
	out := strconv.Itoa(s.rating) + " " + strconv.Itoa(s.wins) + "-" + strconv.Itoa(s.losses) + "-" +
		strconv.Itoa(s.draws) + " last " + strconv.Itoa(s.lastClan) + " per"
	for _, n := range s.perClan {
		out += " " + strconv.Itoa(n)
	}
	return out
}

// seed gives a a standing at rating with one rated win as Pickers, clan 1, and its ladder
// key.
func seed(a address, rating int) {
	clanNumber("Pickers")
	saveStanding(a, &standing{rating: rating, wins: 1, lastClan: 1, perClan: []int{1}})
	ladder, _ = ladder.Set(ladderKey(rating, a), nil)
}

// ladderKeys lists the ladder's keys in order.
func ladderKeys() []string {
	var keys []string
	ladder.TraverseByOffset(0, ladder.Size(), true, true, func(n *avl.Node) bool {
		keys = append(keys, n.Key())
		return false
	})
	return keys
}

// recordOf loads match id as the realm stores it.
func recordOf(t *testing.T, id string) record {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(id)
	urequire.NoError(t, err)
	m, ok := loadMatch(engine.ProofOfConcept(), n)
	urequire.True(t, ok, "match "+id+" is not stored")
	return m
}

// resolveAll plays rounds of [A plan, B plan] with the engine directly.
func resolveAll(rounds ...[2]string) engine.Outcome {
	rules := engine.ProofOfConcept()
	s := rules.Start()
	var o engine.Outcome
	for _, r := range rounds {
		a, _ := rules.PlanOf(strings.Split(r[0], ",")...)
		b, _ := rules.PlanOf(strings.Split(r[1], ",")...)
		o = rules.Resolve(s, a, b)
		s = o.State
	}
	return o
}

func TestWorkedExample(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	a1, b1 := "Chalk Dust,Double Tap", "Hammer Blow,Spiked Shield"

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))

	Play(cross(cur), id, braces)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, "", "", picks, salt3, "", "")

	want := resolveAll([2]string{a1, b1}, [2]string{picks, braces}, [2]string{picks, braces})
	v := Match(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, phaseEnded, v.Phase)
	uassert.Equal(t, resultName(want.Result), v.Result)
	uassert.Equal(t, "hp", v.Reason)
	urequire.Equal(t, 3, len(v.HP))
	uassert.Equal(t, want.State.Gnomes[0].HP, v.HP[2][0])
	uassert.Equal(t, want.State.Gnomes[1].HP, v.HP[2][1])

func showState(s engine.State) string {
	out := "round " + strconv.Itoa(s.Round)
	for _, g := range s.Gnomes {
		out += " | hp " + strconv.Itoa(g.HP) + " vulnerable " + strconv.Itoa(g.Vulnerable) +
			" strength " + strconv.Itoa(g.Strength) + " spent " + strconv.FormatUint(g.Spent, 2)
	}
	return out
}

// After every round of whole matches, the state the realm rebuilds is the engine's own.
func TestStateMatchesEngine(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	rules := engine.ProofOfConcept()
	salts := []string{salt1, salt2, salt3}
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		rounds [][2]string
	}{
		{"worked example", [][2]string{{"Chalk Dust,Double Tap", "Hammer Blow,Spiked Shield"}, {picks, braces}, {picks, braces}}},
		{"knockout", [][2]string{{picks, "Pick,Anvil Stomp"}, {picks, "Hammer Blow,Cobble Throw"}}},
		{"draw", [][2]string{{braces, braces}, {braces, braces}, {braces, braces}}},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		reset()
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
		id := Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salts[0], c.rounds[0][0]), boxOf("box1"), "")
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
		Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, c.rounds[0][1])
		uassert.Equal(t, showState(rules.Start()), showState(stateOf(rules, recordOf(t, id))), c.name+" before round 1")

		for r, plans := range c.rounds {
			deck, deckSalt, next, nextBox := "", "", "", ""
			if r == 0 {
				deck, deckSalt = deckA, saltA
			}
			if r+1 < len(c.rounds) {
				next, nextBox = sealOf(salts[r+1], c.rounds[r+1][0]), boxOf("next")
			}
			testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
			Reveal(cross(cur), id, deck, deckSalt, plans[0], salts[r], next, nextBox)

			at := c.name + " after round " + strconv.Itoa(r+1)
			want := resolveAll(c.rounds[:r+1]...).State
			uassert.Equal(t, showState(want), showState(stateOf(rules, recordOf(t, id))), at)
			hp := Match(id).HP
			urequire.Equal(t, r+1, len(hp), at)
			uassert.Equal(t, want.Gnomes[0].HP, hp[r][0], at)
			uassert.Equal(t, want.Gnomes[1].HP, hp[r][1], at)

			if next != "" {
				testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
				Play(cross(cur), id, c.rounds[r+1][1])
			}
		}
	}
}

		uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "unknown match", func() { Resign(cross(cur), other) }, other)
		uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("match/"+other), "Not found"), other)
	}
}

package arena

import (

	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"

// checkReported checks that the standings realm holds one result more than before, from this
// arena, for alice as Pickers against bob as Ironhide, ending in result. The standings realm
// keeps its state across tests, which reset cannot reach.
func checkReported(t *testing.T, before int, result string) {
	t.Helper()
	urequire.Equal(t, before+1, standings.ResultCount())
	page := standings.Results(before, 1)
	urequire.Equal(t, 1, len(page))
	r := page[0]
	uassert.Equal(t, "gno.land/r/nym-gfanton001/gnomepit/arena/v0", r.Writer)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice.String(), r.Challenger)
	uassert.Equal(t, bob.String(), r.Acceptor)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Pickers", r.ChallengerClan)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Ironhide", r.AcceptorClan)
	uassert.Equal(t, result, r.Result)
}

func TestEndingsReport(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	// The worked match ends on HP with the challenger's last Reveal.
	reset()
	before := standings.ResultCount()
	a1, b1 := "Chalk Dust,Double Tap", "Hammer Blow,Spiked Shield"
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id := Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salt1, a1), boxOf("box1"), "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, b1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, deckA, saltA, a1, salt1, sealOf(salt2, picks), boxOf("box2"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Play(cross(cur), id, braces)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, "", "", picks, salt2, sealOf(salt3, picks), boxOf("box3"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Play(cross(cur), id, braces)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, "", "", picks, salt3, "", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, "hp", Match(id).Reason)
	checkReported(t, before, Match(id).Result)

	// A knockout ends it with the second Reveal.
	reset()
	before = standings.ResultCount()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id = Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salt1, picks), boxOf("box1"), "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, "Pick,Anvil Stomp")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, deckA, saltA, picks, salt1, sealOf(salt2, picks), boxOf("box2"))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Play(cross(cur), id, "Hammer Blow,Cobble Throw")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, "", "", picks, salt2, "", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, "knockout", Match(id).Reason)
	checkReported(t, before, "b")

	// A resignation.
	reset()
	before = standings.ResultCount()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id = Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salt1, picks), boxOf("box1"), "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, braces)
	Resign(cross(cur), id)
	checkReported(t, before, "a")

	// A forfeit claimed by a third wallet.
	reset()
	before = standings.ResultCount()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id = Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salt1, picks), boxOf("box1"), "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, braces)
	testing.SkipHeights(day + 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	ClaimForfeit(cross(cur), id)
	checkReported(t, before, "b")
}

func TestSelfAcceptedMatchUnreported(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	before := standings.ResultCount()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id := Challenge(cross(cur), "Pickers", sealOf(saltA, deckA), sealOf(salt1, picks), boxOf("box1"), "")
	Accept(cross(cur), id, "Ironhide", deckB, braces)

func TestEveryClanNamePassesTheStore(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range engine.ProofOfConcept().Clans {
		uassert.True(t, len(c.Name) >= 1 && len(c.Name) <= 32, c.Name)
	}

package arena

func openRecord(who address, deadline int64) record {
	return record{phase: phaseOpen, challenger: who, deadline: deadline}
}

func showIDs(ids []int) string {
	s := "["
	for i, id := range ids {
		if i > 0 {
			s += " "
		}
		s += strconv.Itoa(id)
	}
	return s + "]"
}

func TestMatchesAcrossChunks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	rules := engine.ProofOfConcept()
	lastID = 130
	for _, id := range []int{1, 64, 65, 130} {
		saveMatch(rules, id, openRecord(alice, int64(id)))
	}
	for _, id := range []int{1, 64, 65, 130} {
		m, ok := loadMatch(rules, id)
		urequire.True(t, ok, "match missing")
		uassert.Equal(t, int64(id), m.deadline)
		uassert.Equal(t, alice, m.challenger)
	}
	for _, id := range []int{66, 0, 131} {
		_, ok := loadMatch(rules, id)
		uassert.False(t, ok)
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, chunks.Size())
}

func TestDropMatch(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	rules := engine.ProofOfConcept()
	lastID = 64
	saveMatch(rules, 1, openRecord(alice, 1))
	saveMatch(rules, 64, openRecord(bob, 64))
	dropMatch(64)
	_, ok := loadMatch(rules, 64)
	uassert.False(t, ok)
	_, ok = loadMatch(rules, 1)
	uassert.True(t, ok)
	dropMatch(64)
	dropMatch(500)
}

func TestPlayerIDs(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(loadPlayer(alice).ids))
	p := loadPlayer(alice)
	p.add(1)
	p.add(5)
	p.add(9)
	p.add(5)
	savePlayer(alice, p)

	p = loadPlayer(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[9 5]", showIDs(p.newest(0, 2)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1]", showIDs(p.newest(2, 2)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[]", showIDs(p.newest(5, 2)))
	p.remove(5)
	p.remove(77)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[9 1]", showIDs(p.newest(0, 50)))
}

func TestPlayerKeepsLocks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	p := loadPlayer(alice)
	p.add(1)
	p.locks = []sessionLock{{session: bob, id: 1, expires: 99}}
	savePlayer(alice, p)
	got := loadPlayer(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(got.locks))
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, got.locks[0].session)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, len(got.ids))
}

func TestOpenList(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	const now = int64(1000)
	openAdd(1, now+10)
	openAdd(2, now+20)
	openAdd(3, now+30)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[3 2]", showIDs(openNewest(now+15, 0, 50)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[2]", showIDs(openNewest(now+15, 1, 1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1 2]", showIDs(openClear(now+25, 8)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[3]", showIDs(openNewest(now, 0, 50)))
	openRemove(9)
	openRemove(3)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", openList)
}

func TestOpenClearStopsAtMax(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	openAdd(1, 10)
	openAdd(2, 20)
	openAdd(3, 30)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1]", showIDs(openClear(100, 1)))
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(openEntries(openList)))
}

func TestDropAbsentMatchLeavesChunk(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	rules := engine.ProofOfConcept()
	lastID = 66
	saveMatch(rules, 65, openRecord(alice, 65))
	before := stringAt(&chunks, chunkKey(65))

	dropMatch(66)
	uassert.Equal(t, before, stringAt(&chunks, chunkKey(65)))

	dropMatch(65)
	dropped := stringAt(&chunks, chunkKey(65))
	dropMatch(65)
	uassert.Equal(t, dropped, stringAt(&chunks, chunkKey(65)))
}

func TestOpenExpiryBoundary(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	openAdd(1, 50)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1]", showIDs(openNewest(50, 0, 50)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[]", showIDs(openClear(50, 8)))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1]", showIDs(openClear(51, 8)))
}
